{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the dtype of revenue
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for thousands separators or other anomalies
print("Unique values in revenue (first 10):", sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check if any values contain commas or other non-numeric characters
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", has_commas.sum())

# Check for any non-numeric values after removing commas
revenue_clean = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
print("Non-numeric values in cleaned revenue:", revenue_clean[~revenue_clean.str.isnumeric()].unique())"}
